5 Painting Mistakes That Ruin Your Home Walls | Avoid These!

Hiring a painter? Make sure they don’t make these 5 common mistakes that cause peeling, bad finish & short paint life.

Top 5 Mistakes Painters Make:
1. No Surface Preparation - Skipping cleaning + sanding makes paint not stick and peel quickly
2. Cheap/Wrong Primer - Low quality primer affects both finish and paint life
3. Extra Thinning of Paint- Too much water reduces coverage + spoils smooth finish  
4. Wrong Tools - Poor brush/roller creates uneven texture + roller marks
